CustomField.formula:
IF( Is_Payroll_Sales__c, "SI-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 2000) & "-" & RIGHT(Name, 4),
IF( Is_Payroll_Purchases__c, "PI-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 2000) & "-" & RIGHT(Name, 4),
IF( OR(Is_General_Ledger_Sales__c, Is_General_Ledger_Purchases__c), "GLI-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 2000) & "-" & RIGHT(Name, 4),
IF( Is_RFQ__c, "RFQ-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 2000) & "-" & RIGHT(Name, 4),
IF( Roaster_Invoice_Entry__c , "RM-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 2000) & "-" & RIGHT(Name, 4),
IF( ICT_Invoice_Entry__c , "ICT-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 2000) & "-" & RIGHT(Name, 4), IF( Is_Service_Invoice__c , "PSI-" & TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - 2000) & "-" & RIGHT(Name, 4), "" ) ) ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: New Format Invoice No
